subject: Social proof asset request — quick 15m to confirm metrics
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@finmetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Social proof asset request — quick 15m to confirm metrics
Attachments: poc-results-onepager.pdf (PDF, 1 page summary)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. The team and I here at Redwood were really pleased with the results and the way FinMetrics integrated Redwood Dedicated into the inference path. I pulled together a short one-pager (attached) that summarizes the outcome we observed. Quick highlights from the POC (end-to-end production-like configuration):

- 95th percentile latency on typical queries: 2.1s -> 0.68s (~67% reduction)
- Median latency improved from 0.9s -> 0.24s (~73% reduction)
- Cost-per-inference: ~$0.012 -> ~$0.0032 (approx 3.8x cost reduction)
- Throughput: sustained 220 qps -> 860 qps with the same reserved capacity profile
- Cold-starts reduced by ~90% after KV-prefix caching and warmed pools

We'd love your help turning this into a short customer asset — a 1–2 sentence quote we can use on the website + logo (if allowed). Would you be open to:

1) A 2-line blurb we can publish (we can draft and send for approval), and
2) A brief 15-minute call to confirm the numbers and any language you prefer (I included my calendar link below).

If helpful, Marissa (cc'd) can draft suggested one-liners and social copy for you to approve. We also asked legal about logo usage — they typically require a short confirmation (we can provide a simple form).

Proposed times: I have 15-min slots tomorrow 11/13 or Monday 11/16 — you can pick a time here: https://cal.com/rachel-kim/15

Thanks — looking forward to getting this out in a way you're comfortable with.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
